bullets.note: ([YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PEJAhM9PtDw), [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/track/6U8IWJDdiHP4PehqHeWFIt), [Apple Music](https://music.apple.com/us/song/granada/534288953)) by Lebanese composer, [oud](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oud) master, and singer [Marcel Khalife](https://www.instagram.com/khalifemarcel/). bullets.title: How I Beat Lyme Disease with The Ketogenic Diet
bullets.note: I started writing this as a reply on X to [Greg Yang](https://x.com/TheGregYang/status/2013652609455006006), co-founder of [xAI](https://x.ai/), who recently stepped down from xAI to address [his debilitating case of Lyme disease](https://x.com/TheGregYang/status/2013652609455006006). Ultimately, I decided that [a blog post](https://tim.blog/2026/01/30/lyme-disease-ketogenic-diet/?utm_campaign=5bf&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_source=convertkit) could provide more detail and allow proofreading by credible scientists, so here we are. The post covers the science, exact how-to protocols, and much more.

bullets.title: My appearance on The Shawn Ryan Show
bullets.note:
Shawn is a former U.S. Navy SEAL and CIA contractor who served for 14 years across multiple combat missions. He led us to some edgy and strange topics that I don’t usually discuss publicly. I had a lot of fun.  
​  
His show is one of the fastest-growing and most popular podcasts in the world, and I was very impressed with the entire operation he’s built. Kudos to Shawn and his entire team.

bullets.title: Alzheimer’s blood tests may be misleading for people with kidney problems
bullets.note: Summary: “A large study found that people with impaired kidneys tend to have higher Alzheimer’s biomarkers, yet they don’t face a higher overall risk of dementia. For those who already have elevated biomarkers, kidney problems may speed up when symptoms appear. The findings show that kidney health can change how Alzheimer’s blood tests are read. Doctors may need to consider both organs to get a clearer picture.” Pair this article with [my brand-new conversation with Dr. Tommy Wood](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tTLLfUoOFLU) on preventing dementia.
